add_env_args: add environment-specific argparse arguments like frameskip and framestack to an ArgumentParser for a given RL environment
env_override_defaults: override default parameter values for a given RL environment by calling its registered override function
review_add_env_args: review the add_env_args function to understand which argparse arguments it registers for RL environments
review_env_override_defaults: review the env_override_defaults function to see how it resolves and calls environment-specific parameter overrides
test_add_env_args: test the add_env_args function by passing an environment name and an ArgumentParser instance
